content: We must live today by what truth we can get today, and be ready tomorrow to call it falsehood.
author: William James
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

William James understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden motive, insecurity, or fear might be silently driving your recent reactions?
